tools.name: check_github_repo
tools.description: Reads up to about thirty public pages of a public GitHub repository and reports which of eight security signals are visible: a security policy that names a contact or a reporting link, a software bill of materials, proof of where releases come from, a lockfile, automatic updates of dependencies, sec

tools.name: check_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Makes one anonymous request to a public x402 payment endpoint, without ever paying, and reports whether its payment request passes the official buyer schema and how far up the receipt ladder the seller gets (does it name what it sells, does it sign its offer, does it return a signed receipt). Use it
